about.title: About
about.p1: Third-year Computer Science student at Collège de Bois-de-Boulogne. I mainly work on backend and full-stack projects involving REST APIs, authentication, databases, system design, and cloud infrastructure.
about.p2: I focus on writing clean, maintainable code and building systems that are secure and easy to understand. Most of my experience comes from building my own projects, solving problems as they appear, and improving the architecture as the projects grow.
about.p3: Outside programming, I train in wrestling, judo and weightlifting, follow financial markets, and spend my summers organizing activities for seniors at a community centre in Montréal.
